fato_historico: 1973: JAT Airways Flight 769 crashes into the Maganik mountain range while on approach to Titograd Airport, killing 35 passengers and six crew.
energia_do_dia: Today, your intuition may flow like a gentle stream, inviting you to navigate life with grace. Even when the clouds gather over rugged peaks, consider that your sensitivity is a superpower. It is a good time to trust the paths you choose, finding comfort in the steady rhythm of your own heart and the quiet whispers of the universe.
frase_do_dia: Your spirit is a mountain peak that always finds the light above the mist.
significado_numero: Represents the stability required to climb towards your highest personal aspirations.
conselho: Trust your internal guidance system even when the surrounding path feels uncertain today.
